newsitem.title: UK: EMI to pay $50 mln severance to U.S. chief - paper.
newsitem.headline: EMI to pay $50 mln severance to U.S. chief - paper.

text.p: EMI Group Plc will pay more than $50 million to the axed chairman of its North American division, Charles Koppelman, the Times newspaper said on Thursday.
The paper said the severance pay, a mix of cash, share options and pension entitlements, made up more than a quarter of the cost of EMI's planned restructuring in north America.
The Times said Koppelman was six months into a new five-year contract with EMI.
EMI confirmed Koppelman's departure on Tuesday when announcing pre-tax profits of 381 million pounds after a prior 367 million pounds.
